shortDescription: It has no plan to sell vehicles in China, said Leon Zheng, Linktour's vice president of sales and marketing. "Chinese Automakers Are Building American-Style Cars — Just Not for Americans," at 9:00p.m. ET on Oct. 14, incorrectly said it was Leon Zhang.
